verdict.rationale: Calendly documents Workflows that automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts, plus a one-click reminder email. These are actions triggered by meetings or done once, not jobs or workflows that the user schedules to recur on a defined cadence. No evidence shows recurring or cron-style job scheduling through the app, the API, or MCP, so the adjacent features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Use Workflows to automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates.
Schedule a reminder email in a single click, so recipients who haven't booked yet don't slip through the cracks.
